article.p: Two-day in-person intensives, each followed by four online sessions. The pathway to becoming a Global TRE™ Certified Provider.
Evening and weekend sessions with Isabelle and visiting Global TRE™ trainers — for coaches, teams and curious beginners.
Peer sessions for providers and trainees: shared tremoring, case discussion and supervision questions. Announced here when scheduled.
One-to-one sessions online or in Singapore, 60–90 minutes, for a personalised introduction or deeper work.

div.h2: Preparing for your online TRE™ session
div.p: Online sessions and group classes run on Zoom. Everything your facilitator can offer you comes through the camera, so a few minutes of set-up makes all the difference.

ol.li: Camera: we must see you head to toe — standing and on the mat. Device about 2–2.5 m away, landscape, at hip height, to the side of your mat.
Kit: a yoga mat, wireless headphones (required in group classes), good lighting, loose light-coloured trousers, water and cushions within reach.
Safety: someone you trust nearby, with their name and phone number on your consent form.
Zoom: install the app, sign in with the email you registered with, test camera and microphone, and join through the app a few minutes early.

div.p: Mats, blankets and water are provided unless the event page says otherwise. Please arrive 10 minutes early. The exact address and directions are sent with your confirmation.
Still have a question about your set-up, the space, the camera or the kit? Ask before your session rather than on the day. WhatsApp us or email bonjour@bhdasia.com.

div.h2: Bring TRE™ to your team or community
div.p: Private group sessions, lunch-and-learns, offsite modules and multi-week programmes for organisations in Singapore. We also co-host events with studios, clinics and practitioner networks.
Release stress, strengthen resilience, improve wellbeing. The home of TRE™ practitioners, trainees and first-timers in Singapore.
